why: Bulgarian newsrooms write an institution's abbreviation; the procurement registry holds its full legal name. „МВР“ and „КПКОНПИ“ exist as EIKs in the corpus but as NO gazetteer surface at all, so the entity linker refused them. This is the crosswalk. Every entry is HAND-VERIFIED against awarder_search and carries the evidence it was verified with.
rules: An entry ASSERTS that this abbreviation means this EIK. It is a claim about a named public body, checked by hand, never derived.

names_on_eik records how many distinct folded names share the EIK as of verified_on. An abbreviation is admitted only when every one of those names is the SAME body — a spelling variant or a unit of it — or when the rendered page was checked directly; see each entry's `evidence`.
A drifting names_on_eik is the signal to re-verify, and the gate compares the stored number against the live corpus.
